title: Reviewer Bulletin: Continued-Stay Days Already at Issue in an Earlier Reconsideration (Appeals and Grievances)
content:
## Reviewer bulletin — Appeals and Grievances: continued-stay days already at issue elsewhere

Applies to an Expedited Medical Necessity Reconsideration taken on a denied continued-stay request for an inpatient mental health stay.

> Days of the continued-stay request already at issue elsewhere are left out: where the stay's earlier reconsideration stands escalated, the days its request asked for beyond what the authorization covers on or before its last valid day are left out wherever the continued-stay request asks for them again; where that earlier reconsideration is still filed or under review, the days it covers beyond those first granted are left out wherever asked for again; in every other case none are left out.

**In calendar terms.** The continued-stay request asks for its days from its request date onward, one calendar day per day requested. The days it already has covered are those from its request date through the earlier authorization's last valid day. The days left out are counted on top of those:

- *Earlier reconsideration escalated:* the calendar days after the earlier authorization's last valid day up to the last day the earlier request asked for (its first valid day plus its days requested, counting the first valid day as day one), wherever they fall among the continued-stay request's days.
- *Earlier reconsideration filed or under review:* the calendar days from the day after the earlier authorization's first-granted days end (its first valid day plus its days first granted, counting the first valid day as day one) up to the last day the earlier request asked for, wherever they fall among the continued-stay request's days.
- *Any other status:* none.

The days at issue are the days requested less the days already covered and less the days left out, never below zero.

**Records read.** The status of the stay's earlier Medical Necessity Reconsideration (the patient's most recently filed); and in Referrals and Authorizations, on the earlier authorization, its first and last valid days, its days requested and its days first granted, and on the continued-stay request its request date and days requested.

**Worked case (hypothetical).** Continued-stay request dated 2026-05-11 for 14 days (11 to 24 May). Earlier authorization: first valid day 1 May, 21 days requested (1 to 21 May), 12 days first granted (1 to 12 May), last valid day 14 May after an extension. Already covered: 11 to 14 May, 4 days.

| Earlier reconsideration | Days left out | Days at issue |
|---|---|---|
| escalated | 15 to 21 May, 7 days | 14 less 4 less 7, which is 3 |
| filed or under review | 13 to 21 May, 9 days | 14 less 4 less 9, which is 1 |
| decided and not escalated, or no earlier case | none | 14 less 4, which is 10 |
